passage:
Every morning, Leo's father read news on his phone before breakfast. One day, he looked worried and said a famous bridge had fallen. Leo searched online and found the same story on many pages.
His sister checked more carefully. The photo was real, but it was from an old accident in another country. Someone had shared it again with a new title.
The family talked about it over toast. Leo learned that seeing the same story many times does not always make it true. False information can spread quickly when people are frightened.
After that day, the family made a rule: before sharing shocking news, check the date, the source, and whether trusted reports say the same thing.
